review: B08 S05/S06 iPad native visual and AX review
observations: S05 normal: version 0.8.0, intro, current feature rows and preserved icons occupy a centered readable column; no overlap or newly clipped visible text.
S05 MAX: Version and 0.8.0 stack, intro wraps completely, and iOS 27 Support row title/summary remain full in AX and scrollable; the first row extends below the initial viewport as expected.

S06 normal/MAX: navigation title, category, full feature title, version badge, symbol hero and complete summary are visible within the centered 680-point column; BackButton remains identified on both.

The S06 iPad MAX hero title is fully visible. The iPhone MAX hero ellipsis previously observed is in unchanged fixed-height symbolHero artwork; main title and AX are complete, so it is an explicit preexisting quality limit, not an introduced finding.
limits: Only the named English, light, normal/MAX states and top/scroll capture points were reviewed; no dark mode or other language inference.
No current Duo native result: the owned empty device failed Data Migration before SDK tests; historical Duo images do not count.
iPad selectors cover manual list→detail→Back; automatic Done is proven by phone selector, not iPad.
MAX row screenshot begins above the fold and AX contains offscreen row content; it does not prove every release row visually.
